title: The symmetric operation in a free Novikov algebra
summary: We study the symmetrization of the Novikov product. Using the embedding of a free Novikov algebra into a commutative differential algebra over a field of characteristic zero, we first obtain a basis for the subalgebra generated by the free generators with respect to the symmetrized product $a\circ b=ab+ba$. Next, using Euler operators (variational derivatives), we give a criterion for recognizing symmetric elements and show that these elements coincide with null Lagrangians in the corresponding differential realization.
